title: 青馬大橋
summary: 青馬大橋主跨 1,377 m，1997 年通車，上層六線公路、下層兩條鐵路軌道與兩條有遮蔽的車道，是承載鐵路的最長跨徑懸索橋。本課從鐵路對橋面坡度與變位的要求、颱風下的行車安全出發，計算空中紡線主纜的主跨與邊跨鋼絲數差異，說明滑模混凝土塔、96 個橋面模組吊裝、伸縮縫與軌道銜接，再以香港路政署的風與結構健康監測系統（WASHMS）、交通量與水上淨空管制，說明營運維護。
summaryEn: Tsing Ma Bridge has a 1,377 m main span and opened in 1997, carrying six road lanes above and two rail tracks plus two sheltered carriageways below, the longest-span suspension bridge carrying rail. The course starts from rail demands on deck gradient and deflection and from vehicle safety in typhoons, derives the difference in wire count between main and side spans of the air-spun cables, explains slipformed concrete towers, lifting 96 deck modules, expansion joints and track continuity, then uses the Highways Department's Wind and Structural Health Monitoring System (WASHMS), traffic data and marine air-draft control to explain operation and maintenance.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 設計練習：估算青馬大橋型懸索橋在公路與鐵路同時加載時的主纜張力增量。假設主跨 l = 1,377 m、垂跨比 1/11（f ≈ 125.2 m），每條主纜主跨鋼絲面積 A ≈ 0.759 m²。公路六車道各 20 kN/m 的 30% 同時作用（36 kN/m），加上兩軌列車各 60 kN/m 的 50%（60 kN/m），總活載 96 kN/m，每纜 48 kN/m。張力增量 ΔH = Δw·l²/(8f) = 48×1,377²/(8×125.2) ≈ 90,900 kN ≈ 91 MN，鋼絲應力增量 ≈ 91/0.759 ≈ 120 N/mm²。若列車改為兩軌全滿（120 kN/m），每纜活載 78 kN/m，ΔH ≈ 148 MN、應力增量約 195 N/mm²，顯示鐵路荷載假設對主纜應力幅與疲勞評估的影響。數值為教學假設，不代表青馬大橋的設計計算。
workedExample.textEn: Design exercise: estimate the main-cable tension increase on a Tsing Ma type suspension bridge under combined road and rail loading. Assume main span l = 1,377 m, sag ratio 1/11 (f ≈ 125.2 m) and main-span wire area per cable A ≈ 0.759 m². Take 30% of 20 kN/m on each of six road lanes acting together (36 kN/m) plus 50% of 60 kN/m on each of two tracks (60 kN/m), a total live load of 96 kN/m, or 48 kN/m per cable. The tension increase ΔH = Δw·l²/(8f) = 48×1,377²/(8×125.2) ≈ 90,900 kN ≈ 91 MN, a wire stress increase of about 91/0.759 ≈ 120 N/mm². With both tracks fully loaded (120 kN/m) the live load per cable becomes 78 kN/m, ΔH ≈ 148 MN and the stress increase about 195 N/mm², showing how rail-load assumptions drive cable stress range and fatigue assessment. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design calculations of Tsing Ma Bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鐵路荷載與橋面變位限制」與「颱風強風與行車安全」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rail loading and deck deflection limits" and "Typhoon winds and vehicle safety": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鐵路荷載與橋面變位限制：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Rail loading and deck deflection limits: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「下層鐵路軌道坡度」如何影響青馬大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lower-deck rail gradient” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tsing Ma Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 公路車輛可以容忍懸索橋在活載下數公尺的起伏，鐵路卻對縱坡變化、軌道扭曲與橋端轉角非常敏感，因為列車的懸吊與輪軌接觸需要平順的幾何。青馬大橋把鐵路放在下層、位於加勁梁的剪力中心附近，並以深桁架提供足夠的彎曲與扭轉勁度；但懸索橋的豎向勁度主要仍來自主纜，半跨加載時的反對稱變形最為不利，會在跨內形成一升一降的波形，使局部坡度增加。設計必須把這種變形換算成軌道坡度與豎曲線半徑，與鐵路營運限值比較。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「下層鐵路軌道坡度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Road vehicles tolerate several metres of live-load movement on a suspension bridge, but rail is very sensitive to gradient change, track twist and end rotation, because train suspension and wheel–rail contact need smooth geometry. Tsing Ma places the railway on the lower deck near the shear centre of the stiffening girder and uses a deep truss for bending and torsional stiffness; yet vertical stiffness still comes mainly from the cables, and half-span loading producing antisymmetric deformation is most adverse, forming a rise and a dip within the span that steepens local gradients. Design must convert this deformation into track gradient and vertical-curve radius and compare them with railway operating limits. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Lower-deck rail gradient” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：設反對稱變形為正弦半波，半波長 λ = l/2 = 688.5 m、振幅 A = 2.35 m，最大附加坡度 = π·A/λ = π×2.35/688.5 ≈ 0.0107，即約 1.07%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Treat the antisymmetric deformation as a sine half-wave with λ = l/2 = 688.5 m and amplitude A = 2.35 m: the maximum added gradient = π·A/λ = π×2.35/688.5 ≈ 0.0107, about 1.07%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「懸索橋只要強度夠，鐵路就可以像在地面一樣行駛。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If a suspension bridge is strong enough, trains can run on it as on the ground." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「下層鐵路軌道坡度」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Lower-deck rail gradient”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「鐵路荷載與橋面變位限制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rail loading and deck deflection limits" is correct?
options: 懸索橋只要強度夠，鐵路就可以像在地面一樣行駛。

steps.title: 鐵路荷載與橋面變位限制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rail loading and deck deflection limits: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「下層鐵路軌道坡度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lower-deck rail gradient” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：設反對稱變形為正弦半波，半波長 λ = l/2 = 688.5 m、振幅 A = 2.35 m，最大附加坡度 = π·A/λ = π×2.35/688.5 ≈ 0.0107，即約 1.07%。若振幅減半，附加坡度約 0.54%；這個附加值要與橋面原有縱坡相加後再與鐵路容許坡度比較。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Treat the antisymmetric deformation as a sine half-wave with λ = l/2 = 688.5 m and amplitude A = 2.35 m: the maximum added gradient = π·A/λ = π×2.35/688.5 ≈ 0.0107, about 1.07%. Halving the amplitude gives about 0.54%; this addition must be combined with the deck's built-in gradient and compared with the permitted rail gradient. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以有限元素模型對公路與鐵路荷載做半跨、全跨與偏心加載組合，輸出軌道高程、坡度、扭曲與橋端轉角；完工後以實際列車與測試車隊做載重試驗，以精密水準與 GNSS 量測變位並與預測比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run half-span, full-span and eccentric combinations of road and rail loading in the finite-element model, outputting track level, gradient, twist and end rotation; after completion load-test with actual trains and test vehicles, measuring movement by precise levelling and GNSS against prediction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 鐵路荷載與橋面變位限制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rail loading and deck deflection limits: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「下層鐵路軌道坡度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lower-deck rail gradient” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以有限元素模型對公路與鐵路荷載做半跨、全跨與偏心加載組合，輸出軌道高程、坡度、扭曲與橋端轉角；完工後以實際列車與測試車隊做載重試驗，以精密水準與 GNSS 量測變位並與預測比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run half-span, full-span and eccentric combinations of road and rail loading in the finite-element model, outputting track level, gradient, twist and end rotation; after completion load-test with actual trains and test vehicles, measuring movement by precise levelling and GNSS against prediction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：鐵路營運單位應從初步設計就參與訂定軌道幾何限值與載重組合，設計報告須列出最不利工況下的軌道坡度、扭曲與橋端轉角，並在通車前以載重試驗驗證。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The railway operator should join from preliminary design to set track-geometry limits and load combinations; the design report must list track gradient, twist and end rotation for the worst cases, verified by load tests before opening.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只檢核主纜強度而未把變形換算成軌道幾何，可能出現列車通過時坡度或扭曲超限，導致限速、乘客不適或軌道部件加速磨耗；橋端轉角過大則使伸縮裝置處的鋼軌產生額外彎曲與疲勞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Checking cable strength without converting deformation into track geometry can let gradient or twist exceed limits under trains, forcing speed restrictions, passenger discomfort or faster wear of track components; excessive end rotation adds bending and fatigue to rails at the expansion devices. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鐵路荷載與橋面變位限制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rail loading and deck deflection limits"?
options: 以有限元素模型對公路與鐵路荷載做半跨、全跨與偏心加載組合，輸出軌道高程、坡度、扭曲與橋端轉角。

steps.title: 鐵路荷載與橋面變位限制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rail loading and deck deflection limits: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「下層鐵路軌道坡度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lower-deck rail gradient” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只檢核主纜強度而未把變形換算成軌道幾何，可能出現列車通過時坡度或扭曲超限，導致限速、乘客不適或軌道部件加速磨耗；橋端轉角過大則使伸縮裝置處的鋼軌產生額外彎曲與疲勞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Checking cable strength without converting deformation into track geometry can let gradient or twist exceed limits under trains, forcing speed restrictions, passenger discomfort or faster wear of track components; excessive end rotation adds bending and fatigue to rails at the expansion devices. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計必須把這種變形換算成軌道坡度與豎曲線半徑，與鐵路營運限值比較。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Design must convert this deformation into track gradient and vertical-curve radius and compare them with railway operating limits.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「懸索橋只要強度夠，鐵路就可以像在地面一樣行駛。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If a suspension bridge is strong enough, trains can run on it as on the ground." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 颱風強風與行車安全：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Typhoon winds and vehicle safety: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「颱風下的遮蔽車道」如何影響青馬大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sheltered lanes in typhoons” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tsing Ma Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 香港位於颱風路徑上，青馬大橋的橋面高程與跨徑使它暴露在強烈陣風中。結構本身要抵抗顫振與抖振，用路人則面臨側風翻車或偏移的風險。青馬大橋的下層除鐵路外設有兩條有遮蔽的車道，平時供維修通行，在特別強烈的颱風中，上層封閉後可作為行車道；強風時也可把交通改到下層並降低速限。這是把結構斷面設計與營運規則結合的例子：車輛安全的控制條件往往比結構強度的控制風速低得多。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「颱風下的遮蔽車道」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hong Kong lies on typhoon tracks, and Tsing Ma's deck height and span expose it to strong gusts. The structure must resist flutter and buffeting, while road users face the risk of crosswind overturning or drift. Besides the railway, the lower deck carries two sheltered carriageways used for maintenance access in normal times and as traffic lanes when the upper deck is closed in particularly severe typhoons; in strong winds traffic can also be moved to the lower deck with reduced speed limits. This shows section design and operating rules working together: the wind speed that governs vehicle safety is usually far lower than the one that governs structural strength. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Sheltered lanes in typhoons” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：風壓 q = ½ρU²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Wind pressure q = ½ρU².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橋梁設計能抵抗颱風，車輛在颱風中通過就一定安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the bridge is designed for typhoons, vehicles crossing in a typhoon must be safe." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「颱風下的遮蔽車道」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 颱風強風與行車安全：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Typhoon winds and vehicle safety: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「颱風下的遮蔽車道」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sheltered lanes in typhoons” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：風壓 q = ½ρU²。U = 50 m/s 時 q ≈ 1,563 Pa，作用在 10 m² 車側得 15.6 kN；作用高度 1.8 m 的傾覆力矩 28.1 kN·m，小於重量 50 kN×半輪距 1.0 m = 50 kN·m 的抵抗力矩。U = 70 m/s 時 q ≈ 3,063 Pa、側力 30.6 kN、力矩 55.1 kN·m > 50 kN·m，空車可能翻覆。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Wind pressure q = ½ρU². At U = 50 m/s, q ≈ 1,563 Pa, giving 15.6 kN on a 10 m² vehicle side; acting at 1.8 m it produces an overturning moment of 28.1 kN·m, below the resisting 50 kN weight × 1.0 m half-track = 50 kN·m. At 70 m/s, q ≈ 3,063 Pa, side force 30.6 kN and moment 55.1 kN·m > 50 kN·m, so an empty vehicle may overturn. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以橋面高度的風速計連續量測平均風與陣風，結合車輛側風試驗或分析訂出分級管制門檻（降速、限制高側車、改道下層、封橋）；每次颱風後檢討實測風速、管制時點與事故紀錄，確認門檻是否需要調整。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure mean and gust wind continuously with deck-level anemometers and, with vehicle crosswind tests or analysis, set staged control thresholds (speed reduction, restricting high-sided vehicles, diverting to the lower deck, closure); after each typhoon review measured wind, timing of controls and incident records to see whether thresholds need adjustment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 風壓 q = ½ρU²。U = 50 m/s 時 q ≈ 1,563 Pa，作用在 10 m² 車側得 15.6 kN；作用高度 1.8 m 的傾覆力矩 28.1 kN·m，小於重量 50 kN×半輪距 1.0 m = 50 kN·m 的抵抗力矩。U = 70 m/s 時 q ≈ 3,063 Pa、側力 30.6 kN、力矩 55.1 kN·m > 50 kN·m，空車可能翻覆。數值為教學假設。

At U = 50 m/s, q ≈ 1,563 Pa, giving 15.6 kN on a 10 m² vehicle side; acting at 1.8 m it produces an overturning moment of 28.1 kN·m, below the resisting 50 kN weight × 1.0 m half-track = 50 kN·m. At 70 m/s, q ≈ 3,063 Pa, side force 30.6 kN and moment 55.1 kN·m > 50 kN·m, so an empty vehicle may overturn. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「颱風下的遮蔽車道」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sheltered lanes in typhoons” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以橋面高度的風速計連續量測平均風與陣風，結合車輛側風試驗或分析訂出分級管制門檻（降速、限制高側車、改道下層、封橋）；每次颱風後檢討實測風速、管制時點與事故紀錄，確認門檻是否需要調整。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：強風管制程序應由業主、交通主管與警方共同訂定，寫明量測位置、平均時間、各級門檻與通知流程；遮蔽車道的照明、排水、緊急出口與標誌須定期測試，確保颱風時能立即啟用。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Strong-wind procedures should be agreed by the owner, transport authority and police, stating measurement locations, averaging time, staged thresholds and notification chains; lighting, drainage, emergency exits and signs in the sheltered lanes must be tested regularly so they can be used immediately in a typhoon.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若管制只依天文台的區域風速而不看橋面實測陣風，可能在橋上陣風已超過安全值時仍開放高側車通行；反之門檻過於保守，則讓重要的機場聯外道路不必要地長時間封閉。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Basing controls only on regional observatory wind instead of measured deck gusts can keep high-sided vehicles moving after gusts on the bridge exceed safe values; overly conservative thresholds needlessly close a vital airport link for long periods. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 空中紡線主纜的邊跨補強絲：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Extra side-span wires in the air-spun cables: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「主跨與邊跨鋼絲數」如何影響青馬大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Main- and side-span wire counts” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tsing Ma Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 青馬大橋兩條主纜直徑約 1.1 m，由 5.38 mm 鍍鋅鋼絲以空中紡線法架設：鋼絲從恆張力供線裝置拉出，經塔頂約 500 t 的鑄鋼索鞍在兩座錨碇間往返。資料庫記載每條主纜在主跨約 33,400 根鋼絲、邊跨約 35,224 根。邊跨主纜傾角較陡，在相同水平張力下軸向張力較大，因此在邊跨額外加入鋼絲，從索鞍以外到錨碇之間補強，而不必讓整條主纜都加粗。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「主跨與邊跨鋼絲數」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tsing Ma's two main cables, each about 1.1 m in diameter, were built from 5.38 mm galvanised wires by aerial spinning: wire drawn from a constant-tension supply was looped between the anchorages over cast saddles of about 500 t on the tower tops. A structures database records about 33,400 wires per cable in the main span and about 35,224 in the side spans. The side-span cables are steeper, so at the same horizontal tension their axial tension is larger; extra wires are therefore added in the side spans between the saddles and anchorages, rather than enlarging the whole cable. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Main- and side-span wire counts” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Wire area is 22.73 mm², so the main-span cable has A = 33,400×22.73 ≈ 759,300 mm²; gross area π/4×1.1² = 0.950 m² gives a void ratio ≈ 1 − 0.759/0.950 ≈ 20%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「主纜從錨碇到錨碇的鋼絲數一定相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A main cable always has the same number of wires from anchorage to anchorage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Main- and side-span wire counts”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 空中紡線主纜的邊跨補強絲：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Extra side-span wires in the air-spun cables: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「主跨與邊跨鋼絲數」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Main- and side-span wire counts” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單絲面積 22.73 mm²，主跨 A = 33,400×22.73 ≈ 759,300 mm²；毛面積 π/4×1.1² = 0.950 m²，空隙率 ≈ 1 − 0.759/0.950 ≈ 20%。邊跨與主跨鋼絲比 35,224/33,400 ≈ 1.055；若邊跨所需面積只由 T = H/cosθ 決定，cosθ ≈ 1/1.055 = 0.948，θ ≈ 18.5°。以上由公開數據推算，θ 的解讀為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Wire area is 22.73 mm², so the main-span cable has A = 33,400×22.73 ≈ 759,300 mm²; gross area π/4×1.1² = 0.950 m² gives a void ratio ≈ 1 − 0.759/0.950 ≈ 20%. The side-to-main wire ratio is 35,224/33,400 ≈ 1.055; if the side-span area were governed only by T = H/cosθ, cosθ ≈ 1/1.055 = 0.948 and θ ≈ 18.5°. Derived from published figures; the angle interpretation is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：紡線時以計數器記錄每束鋼絲數與邊跨補強絲的起訖位置，補強絲的錨固與索鞍內排列須與圖說核對；完成後在主跨與邊跨分別量測直徑與周長，確認兩段的空隙率都在設計範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During spinning count wires per strand and record where the side-span extra wires start and stop, checking their anchorage and arrangement in the saddles against the drawings; afterwards measure diameter and circumference separately in main and side spans to confirm both void ratios are within design range.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Wire area is 22.73 mm², so the main-span cable has A = 33,400×22.73 ≈ 759,300 mm²; gross area π/4×1.1² = 0.950 m² gives a void ratio ≈ 1 − 0.759/0.950 ≈ 20%. The side-to-main wire ratio is 35,224/33,400 ≈ 1.055; if the side-span area were governed only by T = H/cosθ, cosθ ≈ 1/1.055 = 0.948 and θ ≈ 18.5°. Derived from published figures; the angle interpretation is a teaching assumption.

steps.title: 空中紡線主纜的邊跨補強絲：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Extra side-span wires in the air-spun cables: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「主跨與邊跨鋼絲數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Main- and side-span wire counts” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 紡線時以計數器記錄每束鋼絲數與邊跨補強絲的起訖位置，補強絲的錨固與索鞍內排列須與圖說核對；完成後在主跨與邊跨分別量測直徑與周長，確認兩段的空隙率都在設計範圍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During spinning count wires per strand and record where the side-span extra wires start and stop, checking their anchorage and arrangement in the saddles against the drawings; afterwards measure diameter and circumference separately in main and side spans to confirm both void ratios are within design range. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：主纜竣工圖應標示每段的鋼絲數、補強絲起訖位置與索鞍內排列，交接給維護單位；日後開纜檢查或強度評估時，必須用對應區段的鋼絲數計算剩餘安全係數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: As-built cable drawings should show wire counts per segment, where the extra wires start and stop and their arrangement in the saddles, handed over to the maintainer; later cable openings and strength evaluations must use the wire count for the relevant segment when computing remaining safety factors.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：補強絲終止處若未妥善錨固或在索鞍內排列錯位，可能造成局部鋼絲受力集中與滑移；空中紡線若在強風中進行，鋼絲擺動使張力不均，壓擠後產生鬆弛絲並影響耐久性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Poorly anchored or misaligned extra wires at their termination or in the saddles can concentrate force on some wires and let them slip; spinning in strong wind makes wires swing and tension uneven, leaving slack wires after compaction that hurt durability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 50 MPa 塔柱的連續滑模：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「滑模混凝土塔柱」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Slipformed concrete tower legs” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：混凝土在模內停留時間 t = H_f/v。模板高 1.2 m、滑升速度 0.25 m/h：t = 1.2/0.25 = 4.8 h，出模時須達到足以自立且不被拉裂的早期強度。以此速度連續施工，200 m 塔柱約需 200/0.25/24 ≈ 33 天；若因溫度低必須降速到 0.15 m/h，則約需 56 天。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Residence time in the form t = H_f/v. With a 1.2 m form and 0.25 m/h slip rate: t = 1.2/0.25 = 4.8 h, and concrete must have enough early strength to stand and not tear when it emerges. At this rate a 200 m leg takes about 200/0.25/24 ≈ 33 days of continuous work; if cold weather forces 0.15 m/h it takes about 56 days. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以出模處的手指按壓或貫入試驗與溫度紀錄判斷早期強度，調整滑升速度與緩凝劑用量；每數公尺以全站儀與雷射垂準儀量測塔柱中心與扭轉，並以標準養護試體確認 50 MPa 的設計強度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Judge early strength at the form exit by finger-pressure or penetration tests with temperature records, adjusting slip rate and retarder dosage; every few metres survey leg centre and twist with total station and laser plumb, and confirm the 50 MPa design strength with standard-cured specimens.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：滑升過快時混凝土強度不足而塌落或被模板拉裂，過慢則混凝土黏附模板形成水平冷縫與表面撕裂；千斤頂不同步會讓模板扭轉，塔柱出現累積的扭曲與偏斜。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

quiz.explanationEn: Judge early strength at the form exit by finger-pressure or penetration tests with temperature records, adjusting slip rate and retarder dosage; every few metres survey leg centre and twist with total station and laser plumb, and confirm the 50 MPa design strength with standard-cured specimens. steps.title: 50 MPa 塔柱的連續滑模：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Continuous slipforming of 50 MPa tower legs: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「滑模混凝土塔柱」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Slipformed concrete tower legs” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 滑升過快時混凝土強度不足而塌落或被模板拉裂，過慢則混凝土黏附模板形成水平冷縫與表面撕裂；千斤頂不同步會讓模板扭轉，塔柱出現累積的扭曲與偏斜。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Slipping too fast lets weak concrete slump or tear at the form exit, too slow lets it stick to the form and form horizontal cold joints and surface tears; unsynchronised jacks twist the form so the leg accumulates twist and lean. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「滑模越快越好，只要混凝土能泵送上去就行。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Faster slipforming is always better as long as concrete can be pumped up." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 橋面模組製造、運輸與吊裝：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Fabrication, transport and lifting of deck modules: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「96 個橋面模組」如何影響青馬大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “96 deck modules” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tsing Ma Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 青馬大橋的鋼橋面由 96 個模組組成，每個長約 18 m、重約 480 t，鋼構在英國與日本製造，於東莞組裝後以駁船運到橋位，再由主纜上的吊裝門架垂直吊起並掛上吊索；第一個節段於 1994 年底吊裝。雙層桁架模組包含上層公路與下層鐵路的橋面系統，因此模組越完整，海上作業越少，但單次吊重越大、對吊裝門架與主纜局部受力的要求越高。吊裝時機要配合潮汐、航道與天氣窗口。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「96 個橋面模組」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tsing Ma's steel deck comprises 96 modules, each about 18 m long and about 480 t; the steel was fabricated in Britain and Japan, assembled in Dongguan and brought by barge to the site, where lifting gantries on the main cables hoisted each module and attached it to the hangers, the first segment going up in late 1994. Each double-deck truss module includes the road deck above and the rail deck below, so more complete modules mean less marine work but heavier lifts and higher demands on the gantries and local cable forces. Lifts must fit tidal, navigation and weather windows. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “96 deck modules” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：全橋鋼構約 49,000 t ÷ 2,160 m ≈ 22.7 t/m；模組 480 t ÷ 18 m ≈ 26.7 t/m（含部分橋面系統）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Total steelwork of about 49,000 t ÷ 2,160 m ≈ 22.7 t/m; a module of 480 t ÷ 18 m ≈ 26.7 t/m (including part of the deck system).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「模組在工廠做得越大越好，吊裝風險不會因此增加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The bigger the factory-made module the better; lifting risk does not grow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 橋面模組製造、運輸與吊裝：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fabrication, transport and lifting of deck modules: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「96 個橋面模組」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “96 deck modules” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：全橋鋼構約 49,000 t ÷ 2,160 m ≈ 22.7 t/m；模組 480 t ÷ 18 m ≈ 26.7 t/m（含部分橋面系統）。吊裝設計重量考慮 1.1 動力係數為 480×1.1 = 528 t；若門架以四個吊點均分，每點約 132 t。動力係數與吊點配置為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Total steelwork of about 49,000 t ÷ 2,160 m ≈ 22.7 t/m; a module of 480 t ÷ 18 m ≈ 26.7 t/m (including part of the deck system). With a 1.1 dynamic factor the design lift is 480×1.1 = 528 t; shared equally by four lifting points, each carries about 132 t. Dynamic factor and lifting arrangement are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每個模組出廠前量測長度、對角線與接頭孔位，並稱重確認重心；吊裝前檢查門架行走與鎖定、吊索與千斤頂讀值，吊起後量測模組高程與主纜垂度，與施工階段分析逐步比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before shipment measure each module's length, diagonals and joint holes and weigh it to confirm the centre of gravity; before lifting check gantry travel and locking, hoist ropes and jack readings; after lifting measure module level and cable sag against the stage analysis step by step.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 橋面模組製造、運輸與吊裝：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「96 個橋面模組」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “96 deck modules” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每個模組出廠前量測長度、對角線與接頭孔位，並稱重確認重心；吊裝前檢查門架行走與鎖定、吊索與千斤頂讀值，吊起後量測模組高程與主纜垂度，與施工階段分析逐步比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before shipment measure each module's length, diagonals and joint holes and weigh it to confirm the centre of gravity; before lifting check gantry travel and locking, hoist ropes and jack readings; after lifting measure module level and cable sag against the stage analysis step by step. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：吊裝計畫須列出每一吊次的重量、重心、潮汐窗口、最大風速與航道協調，並設吊離底板後暫停檢查的停留點；任何模組重量偏差超過允差都要先由設計者評估。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The lifting plan must list each lift's weight, centre of gravity, tidal window, maximum wind speed and navigation coordination, with a hold point to pause and check once the module clears the barge; any weight deviation beyond tolerance needs the designer's assessment first.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：模組實際重量或重心與設計不符，會使吊點受力不均、模組傾斜並碰撞已安裝節段；駁船定位不良或在潮流變化時起吊，可能造成擺盪與吊具過載。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A module whose weight or centre of gravity differs from design loads lifting points unevenly, tilting it into installed segments; poor barge positioning or lifting as the tide turns can cause swinging and overload the rigging. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.

steps.title: 橋面模組製造、運輸與吊裝：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fabrication, transport and lifting of deck modules: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「96 個橋面模組」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “96 deck modules” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 模組實際重量或重心與設計不符，會使吊點受力不均、模組傾斜並碰撞已安裝節段；駁船定位不良或在潮流變化時起吊，可能造成擺盪與吊具過載。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A module whose weight or centre of gravity differs from design loads lifting points unevenly, tilting it into installed segments; poor barge positioning or lifting as the tide turns can cause swinging and overload the rigging. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The bigger the factory-made module the better; lifting risk does not grow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 伸縮縫預設與鋼軌連續：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Expansion-joint presetting and rail continuity: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「伸縮縫與鐵路調節器」如何影響青馬大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joints and rail expansion devices” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tsing Ma Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 懸索橋橋面的縱向位移包括溫度、活載下主纜變形帶動的位移與風、地震造成的移動。資料庫記載青馬大橋伸縮縫的溫度位移約 ±835 mm。公路伸縮縫可用模數式裝置容納，鐵路則需要鋼軌伸縮調節器，讓鋼軌在橋梁與路堤之間滑動而保持軌距與平順。安裝時必須依當時的橋面溫度設定開口，並確認全橋完工荷重已到位，否則溫度與荷重造成的位移會讓裝置在一端提早頂死。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「伸縮縫與鐵路調節器」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Longitudinal movement of a suspension deck comes from temperature, from cable deformation under live load and from wind and earthquake. A structures database records the thermal movement at Tsing Ma's expansion joints as about ±835 mm. Road joints can absorb this with modular devices, but rail needs rail expansion devices that let the rail slide between bridge and embankment while keeping gauge and smoothness. At installation the opening must be set for the deck temperature at the time, and the full completed dead load must already be in place, otherwise thermal and load movement will make the device bottom out early at one end. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Joints and rail expansion devices” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：純溫度位移 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Pure thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「伸縮縫的行程只要按溫度變化計算就夠了。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Expansion-joint travel only needs to be calculated from temperature change." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「伸縮縫與鐵路調節器」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Joints and rail expansion devices”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 伸縮縫預設與鋼軌連續：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Expansion-joint presetting and rail continuity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「伸縮縫與鐵路調節器」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joints and rail expansion devices” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：純溫度位移 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。取等效長度 L = 1,000 m、α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ /°C、相對於安裝溫度 ±20 °C：ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,000×20 = ±0.24 m。與 ±835 mm 比較，可知其餘大部分位移來自活載與風引起的縱向移動，因此不能只用溫度決定裝置行程。L 與 ΔT 為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Pure thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT. With an effective length L = 1,000 m, α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ /°C and ±20 °C from the installation temperature: ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,000×20 = ±0.24 m. Compared with about ±835 mm, most of the remaining movement comes from longitudinal motion under live load and wind, so device travel cannot be set from temperature alone. L and ΔT are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：安裝前以溫度計量測橋面與鋼構溫度，依預設表計算開口並由監造見證；通車前以列車與車隊試驗量測伸縮縫與鋼軌調節器的位移、軌距與高差，並以長期位移計確認位移—溫度關係符合預測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before installation measure deck and steel temperatures, compute the opening from the preset table and have it witnessed; before opening measure joint and rail-device movement, gauge and level difference under train and vehicle tests, and confirm with long-term displacement transducers that movement follows the predicted temperature relation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Compared with about ±835 mm, most of the remaining movement comes from longitudinal motion under live load and wind, so device travel cannot be set from temperature alone. steps.instruction: 安裝前以溫度計量測橋面與鋼構溫度，依預設表計算開口並由監造見證；通車前以列車與車隊試驗量測伸縮縫與鋼軌調節器的位移、軌距與高差，並以長期位移計確認位移—溫度關係符合預測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.observation: 現場實務：伸縮縫與鋼軌調節器的安裝程序要由橋梁與鐵路兩方共同簽認，記錄安裝溫度、開口與當時的施工荷重狀態；營運期把兩者的位移資料放在同一監測平台判讀。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The installation procedure for road joints and rail expansion devices should be signed by both bridge and railway parties, recording installation temperature, opening and the construction-load state at the time; in service interpret both sets of movement data on one monitoring platform.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：預設開口錯誤時，夏季或強風下裝置頂死，產生大縱向力推動塔與錨碇；鋼軌調節器若位移超出範圍，軌距變化與高差可能導致列車限速甚至停駛。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A wrong preset opening can bottom out the device in summer or strong wind, pushing large longitudinal forces into towers and anchorages; a rail expansion device moving beyond its range can change gauge and level enough to force speed restrictions or stop trains. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 預設開口錯誤時，夏季或強風下裝置頂死，產生大縱向力推動塔與錨碇；鋼軌調節器若位移超出範圍，軌距變化與高差可能導致列車限速甚至停駛。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 風與結構健康監測系統的設計：機制與傳力路徑

steps.objective: 說明「WASHMS 感測網」如何影響青馬大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “WASHMS sensor network” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tsing Ma Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 香港路政署為策略性長跨橋梁維持一套專用的風與結構健康監測系統（WASHMS），青馬大橋與汀九橋、汲水門大橋同在其中。系統以風速計量測來流，加速度計、GNSS、位移計、溫度計與應變計記錄橋梁反應，並把資料集中處理。不同感測器各有適用頻帶：GNSS 直接量測位移，適合長週期的大變位；加速度計對高頻敏感，但積分成低頻位移時誤差會快速累積。設計監測系統就是讓每一個要回答的工程問題都有適合的感測器。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「WASHMS 感測網」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hong Kong's Highways Department maintains a dedicated Wind and Structural Health Monitoring System (WASHMS) for strategic long-span bridges, with Tsing Ma alongside Ting Kau and Kap Shui Mun. Anemometers measure incoming wind; accelerometers, GNSS, displacement transducers, thermometers and strain gauges record the bridge's response, and data are processed centrally. Each sensor has its own useful frequency band: GNSS measures displacement directly and suits large long-period movement, while accelerometers are sensitive at high frequency but accumulate error quickly when integrated to low-frequency displacement. Designing a monitoring system means giving each engineering question a suitable sensor. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “WASHMS sensor network” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：簡諧運動位移 A = a/(2πf)²。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「感測器越多，監測系統就越能反映橋梁的安全狀態。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The more sensors, the better a monitoring system reflects bridge safety." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 風與結構健康監測系統的設計：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Designing the wind and structural health monitoring system: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「WASHMS 感測網」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “WASHMS sensor network” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：簡諧運動位移 A = a/(2πf)²。若某模態 f = 0.10 Hz、加速度振幅 a = 0.02 m/s²：(2πf)² = 0.395，A = 0.02/0.395 ≈ 0.051 m（約 5 cm）。GNSS 精度約 1 至 2 cm 即可分辨；若同樣加速度發生在 1.0 Hz，位移只有約 0.5 mm，必須靠加速度計。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Harmonic displacement A = a/(2πf)². For a mode at f = 0.10 Hz with acceleration amplitude a = 0.02 m/s²: (2πf)² = 0.395 and A = 0.02/0.395 ≈ 0.051 m (about 5 cm), which GNSS at 1 to 2 cm accuracy can resolve; the same acceleration at 1.0 Hz gives only about 0.5 mm, which needs accelerometers. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每類感測器在安裝前做出廠校正，安裝後以已知事件（例如列車通過、溫度日循環）檢查訊號合理性；GNSS 與加速度計在重疊頻帶內互相比對，風速計則比對不同位置的平均風速；建立資料完整率與異常值的每月報告。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate every sensor type before installation, then check signal plausibility against known events such as train passages and daily temperature cycles; compare GNSS and accelerometers in their overlapping band and anemometers across locations; issue monthly reports on data completeness and outliers.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “WASHMS sensor network” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每類感測器在安裝前做出廠校正，安裝後以已知事件（例如列車通過、溫度日循環）檢查訊號合理性；GNSS 與加速度計在重疊頻帶內互相比對，風速計則比對不同位置的平均風速；建立資料完整率與異常值的每月報告。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.observation: 現場實務：監測系統規格應從「要回答哪些問題」出發，列出每個問題的感測器、取樣率、精度與判讀責任人；資料格式、時間同步與後設資料（位置、方向、校正）須文件化，以便感測器更換後仍能延續長期序列。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Specify the monitoring system from the questions it must answer, listing for each the sensors, sampling rate, accuracy and the person responsible for interpretation; document data format, time synchronisation and metadata (location, orientation, calibration) so long-term series continue after sensor replacement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若感測器配置只追求數量而沒有對應的工程問題，系統會累積大量無人判讀的資料；時間不同步或座標方向錯誤，則會讓模態辨識與風—反應關係完全失真。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A layout driven by sensor count rather than engineering questions piles up data nobody interprets; unsynchronised clocks or wrong axis orientation completely distort mode identification and wind–response relationships. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Typhoon buffeting records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tsing Ma Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 抖振是紊流中的陣風對橋面持續施加隨機力所引起的振動，不會像顫振那樣發散，但決定了颱風中橋面的位移、加速度與構件應力循環。準靜態理論顯示，抖振力與平均風速平方成正比，因此反應的均方根值大致隨風速平方增長；若某次颱風的實測反應明顯偏離歷次紀錄的趨勢，可能代表風向特殊、感測器問題，或結構阻尼、勁度出現變化。長期累積的颱風紀錄因此成為判斷橋梁狀態的重要基準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「颱風抖振紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Buffeting is vibration caused by gusts in turbulent wind applying a continuous random force to the deck; it does not diverge like flutter, but it sets deck displacement, acceleration and member stress cycles in a typhoon. Quasi-steady theory makes buffeting force proportional to the square of mean wind speed, so the RMS response grows roughly with wind speed squared; if a typhoon's measured response departs clearly from the trend of earlier records, it may indicate an unusual wind direction, a sensor problem or a change in structural damping or stiffness. Accumulated typhoon records therefore become an important baseline for judging the bridge's condition. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Typhoon buffeting records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Typhoon buffeting records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：準靜態近似 σ ≈ k·U²。若平均風速 20 m/s 時側向位移均方根 σ = 0.05 m，則 35 m/s 時 σ ≈ 0.05×(35/20)² ≈ 0.153 m；若實測為 0.25 m，比趨勢高約 63%，應先排查風向與紊流，再檢查阻尼與支承狀態。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Quasi-steady approximation σ ≈ k·U². Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把每次颱風的資料按 10 分鐘平均風速、風向與紊流強度分段，繪出反應均方根與風速的對數圖，擬合指數與係數；新事件落在歷史信賴區間之外時，啟動資料品質檢查與結構檢查，並比較辨識出的模態頻率與阻尼。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Bin each typhoon's data by 10-minute mean wind speed, direction and turbulence intensity, plot RMS response against wind speed on log axes and fit exponent and coefficient; when a new event falls outside the historical confidence band, start data-quality and structural checks and compare identified modal frequencies and damping.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「交通成長與疲勞壽命」與「橋下維修與航運協調」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 交通成長與疲勞壽命：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Traffic growth and fatigue life: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「公路與鐵路疲勞循環」如何影響青馬大橋的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Road and rail fatigue cycles” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tsing Ma Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 青馬大橋同時承受公路車流與鐵路列車，鋼桁架節點、吊索端部與橋面系統焊道都在每次重車或列車通過時經歷應力循環。運輸署統計顯示，大嶼山幹線在 2016 年的日均車流約 87,764 架次，全年約 3,210 萬架次，且十年間持續成長。疲勞設計通常以設計當時的交通預測為基礎，若實際交通量與重車比例增長更快，累積損傷會提早到達，因此營運期要以實際交通與應變量測更新剩餘壽命。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「公路與鐵路疲勞循環」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tsing Ma carries both road traffic and trains, and steel truss joints, hanger ends and deck welds go through a stress cycle with every heavy vehicle or train. Transport Department statistics show an average daily flow of about 87,764 vehicles on the Lantau Link in 2016, about 32.1 million a year, growing steadily over the decade. Fatigue design is usually based on traffic forecasts made at design time; if traffic and the heavy-vehicle share grow faster, accumulated damage arrives early, so remaining life must be updated in service with actual traffic and strain measurements. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Road and rail fatigue cycles” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：S–N 曲線 N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: S–N curve N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「疲勞只與車輛最大重量有關，交通量多寡不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 交通成長與疲勞壽命：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Traffic growth and fatigue life: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「公路與鐵路疲勞循環」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Road and rail fatigue cycles” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：S–N 曲線 N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³。取細部類別 Δσ_C = 90 MPa、等效應力範圍 Δσ = 15 MPa：N = 2×10⁶×(90/15)³ = 4.32×10⁸ 次。若每年 3.2×10⁶ 次有效重車循環，壽命約 135 年；若重車循環增加 50% 到 4.8×10⁶ 次/年，壽命降為約 90 年。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: S–N curve N = 2×10⁶·(Δσ_C/Δσ)³. With detail category Δσ_C = 90 MPa and equivalent stress range Δσ = 15 MPa: N = 2×10⁶×(90/15)³ = 4.32×10⁸ cycles. At 3.2×10⁶ effective heavy-vehicle cycles a year the life is about 135 years; if heavy cycles grow 50% to 4.8×10⁶ a year, the life falls to about 90 years. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在代表性疲勞熱點貼應變計做長期監測，以雨流計數法得到應力範圍直方圖，計算等效應力範圍與年損傷；同時取得動態地磅或交通統計，建立車流與損傷的關係，定期以磁粉或超音波檢查熱點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Install strain gauges at representative fatigue hot spots for long-term monitoring, derive stress-range histograms by rainflow counting, and compute the equivalent stress range and annual damage; obtain weigh-in-motion or traffic statistics to relate traffic to damage, and inspect hot spots periodically by magnetic-particle or ultrasonic testing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 交通成長與疲勞壽命：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Traffic growth and fatigue life: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「公路與鐵路疲勞循環」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Road and rail fatigue cycles” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在代表性疲勞熱點貼應變計做長期監測，以雨流計數法得到應力範圍直方圖，計算等效應力範圍與年損傷；同時取得動態地磅或交通統計，建立車流與損傷的關係，定期以磁粉或超音波檢查熱點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Install strain gauges at representative fatigue hot spots for long-term monitoring, derive stress-range histograms by rainflow counting, and compute the equivalent stress range and annual damage; obtain weigh-in-motion or traffic statistics to relate traffic to damage, and inspect hot spots periodically by magnetic-particle or ultrasonic testing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：營運單位應每年把交通統計與疲勞監測資料送交結構工程師更新剩餘壽命，並依結果調整熱點檢查頻率；重大交通政策改變（例如收費或路網調整）前後，應比較重車循環數的變化。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The operator should send traffic statistics and fatigue monitoring data to the structural engineer each year to update remaining life and adjust hot-spot inspection frequency; before and after major traffic-policy changes such as tolling or network changes, compare the number of heavy-vehicle cycles.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：疲勞裂縫多從焊趾或螺栓孔開始，初期很小且被塗層遮蔽，若檢查頻率不足，裂縫可能擴展到主要構件；鐵路列車的軸重與頻率若高於設計假設，橋面系統的縱梁與橫梁連接最先受影響。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Fatigue cracks usually start at weld toes or bolt holes, small and hidden by coating at first; with infrequent inspection they can grow into primary members. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instructionEn: Fatigue cracks usually start at weld toes or bolt holes, small and hidden by coating at first; with infrequent inspection they can grow into primary members. steps.title: 橋下維修與航運協調：機制與傳力路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Marine air-draft control hours” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tsing Ma Bridge”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 懸索橋的橋面下方檢查、塗裝與構件更換常需要吊籃、工作平台或移動式維修門架，它們會降低橋下的有效淨空。香港路政署依《船舶及港口管制規例》與《商船（本地船隻）（一般）規例》發布公告，指定船舶進入青馬大橋範圍須遵守的時段，分全日與部分時段管制，並設 24 小時熱線。維修規劃因此不只是結構問題，而是要把作業高度、時段與航道使用協調起來，並讓船公司提前知道。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「水上淨空管制時段」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 橋下維修與航運協調：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水上淨空管制時段」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Marine air-draft control hours” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：橋面下表面積估算 41 m × 2,160 m ≈ 88,560 m²。若一部維修門架每夜可完成約 600 m² 的近距離檢查，全面檢查需約 88,560/600 ≈ 148 個夜間作業；若只能在每月約 17 個全日管制日中工作，約需 9 個月。產能與管制日數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Deck underside area ≈ 41 m × 2,160 m ≈ 88,560 m². If one maintenance gantry completes close inspection of about 600 m² a night, a full inspection needs about 88,560/600 ≈ 148 night shifts; if work is allowed only on about 17 full-restriction days a month, it takes about 9 months. Productivity and restriction days are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每次作業前確認公告時段、門架與吊籃的最低點高程，並以實測高程換算當時潮位下的淨空；作業後記錄檢查覆蓋範圍與發現事項，納入構件資料庫，並追蹤未完成區域的排程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before each shift confirm the notified hours and the lowest point of gantries and cradles, converting measured levels to clearance at the current tide; afterwards record inspection coverage and findings in the component database and track the schedule for areas not yet done.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Marine air-draft control hours” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每次作業前確認公告時段、門架與吊籃的最低點高程，並以實測高程換算當時潮位下的淨空；作業後記錄檢查覆蓋範圍與發現事項，納入構件資料庫，並追蹤未完成區域的排程。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.observation: 現場實務：長期維修計畫應包含年度的水上淨空管制時段需求，提前與海事主管協調並公告；交接文件要列出維修門架的運行範圍、最低高程與緊急收回程序。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The long-term maintenance plan should include the annual need for air-draft control hours, coordinated and announced early with the marine authority; handover documents should list the operating range, lowest level and emergency retraction procedure of the maintenance gantries.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若維修設備在非管制時段伸出橋下或高度超出預告，可能與通過的船舶碰撞；檢查只在方便的區段進行而沒有覆蓋紀錄，則某些區段可能多年未被近距離檢查。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Maintenance equipment protruding below the deck outside notified hours or above announced levels can be struck by passing ships; inspections done only where convenient, without coverage records, can leave some zones uninspected at close range for years. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.observation: 連結機制：維修規劃因此不只是結構問題，而是要把作業高度、時段與航道使用協調起來，並讓船公司提前知道。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Maintenance planning is thus not only a structural question but one of coordinating working heights, hours and channel use, and telling ship operators in advance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「橋梁維修只要封閉車道即可，與海上航運無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Bridge maintenance only needs lane closures and has nothing to do with shipping." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Maintenance equipment protruding below the deck outside notified hours or above announced levels can be struck by passing ships; inspections done only where convenient, without coverage records, can leave some zones uninspected at close range for years.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
